hook: AI agents now run some of DeepMind's experiments.

beats.say: Google DeepMind lets AI agents run experiments on their own for the next Gemini model, using part of the lab's compute, though recursive self improvement remains distant.
Gemini lead Koray Kavukcuoglu says DeepMind now relies on one general purpose model for science and products, instead of separate teams for projects like AlphaFold.
Each Gemini generation is a hand built one off, he says, and AGI won't begin until everyday products earn enough trust for people to hand decisions over.
